_comment: testpick prototype settings. World frame = the main project's (sim_config.json): table top at z=0, robot base axis at x=y=0, arm looking along +x. Lengths in m, angles in degrees.
_scan_point_comment: Where the part's bounding-box centre is held while scanning: 30 cm above the table top, over the free part of the table, well inside the EC66's reach.

camera._comment: Camera shape on a post standing on the table, in front of (+x) and above the scan point, looking down at it. distance/elevation/azimuth place it relative to scan_point: azimuth 0 = camera on the +x side.
camera.name: scan_cam

scan._hit_radius_comment: auto = 1.2 x ray spacing at the scan distance; or a number in m.
scan._up_dot_comment: Points whose |normal . UP| exceeds this are top/bottom faces and are not scanned (unless --include-top-bottom).

nbv._tilt_comment: Tilt > 0 turns the part's top towards the camera.
nbv._min_top_comment: A view is rejected when the part's top points within this angle of the camera, or its bottom within this angle of straight up (unless --include-top-bottom).
